item.title: Correct take. 99% of tokens in the world will get consumed in an enterprise context. They will be for writing code, combing through insane amounts of life sciences research, automating manufacturing, securing enterprises, detecting fraud, and thousands of other tasks like this that have significan...
item.description:
作者：Aaron Levie 账号：@levie 简介：ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
Correct take. 99% of tokens in the world will get consumed in an enterprise context.
They will be for writing code, combing through insane amounts of life sciences research, automating manufacturing, securing enterprises, detecting fraud, and thousands of other tasks like this that have significant economic value. This is both where the cost of AI can be most justified but also where the impact of parallel workers doing tasks on your behalf is most useful.
Even the agents that most impact consumers will often be wrapped up as just end to end services where the consumer doesn’t think about there being an AI system on the other end, like faster insurance or onboarding to a bank.
The key though is it’s going to take years for diffusion of agents across the economy because workflows have to re-engineered to incorporate AI, which is a complete change to how most work happens today. Anyone who’s expecting this to happen overnight should be updating their timelines.

How to use my new /human-review skill to edit HTML and Markdown files directly:
1. Tell Codex or Claude Code: “Install this: https://t.co/VDArIG0lxf”
2. Type “/human-review (your doc name)”
3. It’ll open a visual editor where you can edit and format text directly, resize images, and leave feedback for AI like comments in a Google Doc

item.description:
作者：Madhu Guru 账号：@realmadhuguru 简介：Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
Been thinking about why AI diffusion has been slow.
It’s because we are asking users to understand our nerdy lab speak.
We greet them with a blank window and ask them to write a prompt. Then they have to pick a model, decide whether they need an agent, and somehow know what context windows, reasoning, MCP, memory, and skills are.
Most people don’t care. They need a thing done. If you can give them something that does that, they’re happy.
I think we will see that breakthrough product in the next 12 months.
